# Raish Momin — Full Stack Developer & DevOps Engineer

> Freelance, remote, worldwide. 4+ years production experience in Next.js, React, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS.

## Site overview

This is the portfolio and engagement hub for Raish Momin, an independent full-stack
engineer specializing in four focused offerings: Next.js development, MERN stack
applications, DevOps & AWS consulting, and Node.js API/backend engineering.

- Primary URL: https://raish-momin.vercel.app
- Sitemap: https://raish-momin.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- RSS feed: https://raish-momin.vercel.app/feed.xml

## About Raish Momin

Raish Momin is a remote-first freelance engineer with 4+ years of production
experience. Stack defaults are Next.js 14 (App Router with Server Components),
Node.js 20 LTS, TypeScript (strict), MongoDB or PostgreSQL, and AWS (ECS, Lambda,
RDS, S3) on top of Terraform-managed infrastructure.

Typical engagements are 6–12 weeks for greenfield MVPs or open-ended weekly
retainers for ongoing platform work. Async-first; overlaps 4+ hours with US
Eastern and full days with EU/MENA/APAC time zones. Committed to 1–2 active
clients at a time — no agency-style fan-out.

## Services

### Next.js development
Production App Router applications, Server Components by default, ISR with
tag-based revalidation, edge runtime where it matters, Lighthouse 95+ on real
hardware. Migration work from Pages Router → App Router supported.
URL: https://raish-momin.vercel.app/services/nextjs-development

### MERN stack development
End-to-end MongoDB + Express/Fastify + React + Node.js applications.
TypeScript end-to-end, indexed Mongo schemas modeled around access patterns,
JWT + RBAC auth, optional real-time via Socket.IO.
URL: https://raish-momin.vercel.app/services/mern-stack-development

### DevOps & AWS consulting
CI/CD pipeline rewrites (typical target: <5min deploys), Terraform IaC, AWS
cost optimization (typical 20–40% savings in first month), ECS / EKS, GitHub
Actions or GitLab CI, Grafana + OpenTelemetry observability.
URL: https://raish-momin.vercel.app/services/devops-aws-consulting

### API & backend development
REST and GraphQL APIs in Node.js (TypeScript) or Go. Versioned URLs, OpenAPI
3.1 specs that match implementation, per-route rate limiting, idempotency
keys, BullMQ background jobs, k6 load tests in CI.
URL: https://raish-momin.vercel.app/services/api-backend-development

## Working style

- Written scope before code. Fixed deliverables, fixed milestones.
- Weekly demos on a Vercel preview URL.
- GitHub PR-based flow, conventional commits, squash merges.
- Each PR has a Lighthouse delta and a bundle-size delta — regressions fail review.
- Integration tests against real databases (testcontainers), not mocks.
- Tests on critical paths (auth, payments) at 100%; routes at ~80%.
- Observability before features: structured logs (pino), OpenTelemetry traces,
  Grafana dashboards with SLO-based alerts.

## Pricing

- Next.js / MERN / API: from $2,500/week
- DevOps & AWS: from $3,000/week (often retainer)
- MVP fixed-price builds: from $8,000

Contracts via written SOWs. Payment 50% upfront for fixed-price, weekly net-7
for retainers, USD or EUR, wire or Stripe. Mutual NDAs welcome.
